name: an Undo after its act settled reserves, projects and restores each field, and settles with what changed
an Undo requested before every segment settles waits for each source: a refused one owns nothing and its slot settles unnumbered
an inverse slot whose source is still held stops numbering, a restart included, until the source is authoritative
an edit queued after an Undo wins: the restore's ACK reclocks it above the server's fresh stamp
a field written away and back since its act skips on its own; its sibling restores
a Redo takes back only what its Undo applied
a candidate a pending local edit masks stays: that edit is refused, and the restore still applies
a materialized inverse replays after an epoch change only through its own entry, every operation skipping the other epoch
a foreign edit between the creation and a later write of the same act breaks the row history: the created record stays, counted skipped
a record whose every write since its creation is the act's own is deleted by its Undo
a product inverse runs over the engine's evidence: the created board dies with its tree and the parent takes back its title
a product inverse whose created tree grew since skips whole, and nothing changes
explicit inverse slots replace the stored recipes whole: a source they name nothing for restores nothing
inverse slots that name a target the act never journaled throw malformed and change nothing
an act still wholly held is cancelled in place; asking again answers the same request, and an act with no journal is unavailable
a Redo of a held cancellation writes back each change against the accepted version it found and creates the record again
a Redo whose change now reads a pending entry's write waits for that entry's accepted version, then binds it
a held write a later local edit masks takes nothing out when cancelled, and its Redo restores nothing
a Discard at sign-in settles a pending inverse skipped and withdraws its values
a Redo writes back the act's own value, never a later local edit the server refused
an Undo never erases a write the device had not seen when it acted: the field skips, and the other device's write stays under the act's
an Undo of a text the server merged with another device's edit skips, keeping the merged words

name: a held product command leaves no generic redo: its Redo is unavailable without the product's slots, and takes them when given
a Redo whose change now reads an ordinary pending edit binds that edit's accepted write and applies
a held cancellation keeps the act's own creation for its Redo, not a later gesture's edit of the record
a result whose inverse outcomes are malformed still acknowledges its entry, settles its slot skipped invalid, reports it, and later work goes on
a segment named with no recipes journals its receipts, which prove the tree its act created to the act's Undo
a created tree another segment of the act wrote is unproven without that segment's receipt, and the Undo skips
an act whose Undo names no recipe at all throws malformed before anything changes
an Undo of a delete whose death the replica already pulled draws the record back at once, with the fields it had
a Redo of a created record's Undo draws the record back at once, with the fields the Undo took away
an Undo of a revival of a tag the device knew only by its spent id walks from the dead row that id keeps, and the tag dies again with its label back
an Undo of a revival from a spent id that keeps no seq skips: nothing proves the revival wrote over the row the server held
an Undo of a revival from a spent id skips when another device wrote the tag before the revival reached the server
an Undo requested before a write map redirects its act's tree follows the act into the redirected tree
a cancellation of a held act in a tree a write map then redirects keeps its Redo in the redirected tree
an Undo after a write map redirects the board its preimage names restores the redirected id
an Undo reserved before a write map redirects the board its operation names restores the redirected id
a Redo after a write map redirects the board its act wrote writes back the redirected id
a Redo of a held act cancelled before a write map redirects the board it wrote writes the redirected id
a Redo of a held creation cancelled before a write map joins the run it named creates it in the joined run
an Undo of a removal brings back a record whose birth, by an act that keeps no journal, was still unsent when it was removed
an Undo of a removal asked before the record's birth or removal was sent draws it at once and brings it back once both went up
an Undo of a removal brings back a record whose birth went up alone before it was removed
an Undo of a removal brings back a record whose birth the server acknowledged before the device pulled it, the removal's preimage read over that birth's row
an Undo of a removal brings back a record whose birth and removal each went up alone
an Undo of a removal skips when another device wrote the record between its birth and its removal
an Undo of a removal skips when the record's birth was an ordinary entry, whose answer proves nothing of the row it wrote
a preimage never steps over an earlier segment of its own act, which the act read it before
an Undo asked signed out of a removal whose record was born there brings it back once sign-in adds the work and sends it
an Undo of a removal walks over two acknowledged own writes of the record in commit order, its birth and then its rename
